calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_period ASC
LIMIT 30

SELECT 
  s.format,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipt_count,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 2
  AND s.store_id < 900  -- exclude online (900) and web orders
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY s.format

SELECT 
  s.format,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) AS return_lines,
  SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned,
  SUM(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
FROM fact_return_line r
INNER JOIN fact_sales_line f ON r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 2
  AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY s.format

calls.statement:
WITH sales_by_format AS (
  SELECT 
    s.format,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY s.format
),
returns_by_format AS (
  SELECT 
    s.format,
    SUM(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  INNER JOIN fact_sales_line f ON r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY s.format
)
SELECT 
  sales.format,
  sales.net_sales,
  COALESCE(returns.refund_net, 0) AS refund_net,
  ROUND(COALESCE(returns.refund_net, 0) / sales.net_sales * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sales_by_format sales
LEFT JOIN returns_by_format returns ON sales.format = returns.format
ORDER BY sales.format

  COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS store_count
FROM dim_store s

  AND s.store_id < 900
